answer: An agent market sets a 24-hour horizon for identity checks. Each new account locks a bond and receives a unique challenge to reconcile signed readings from an ember-monitoring camera and an ocean buoy. Independent peers verify both signatures, recompute the result, and reject reused proofs. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond and perform fresh verifiable work for every fake identity; forged data or duplicate proofs cause bond forfeiture.
